scope: Donor-complete, record-paired outcome readout over frozen public per-view evidence; no emitter retraining.
key_mechanistic_outcome: mean posterior L1 drift(false_split_m8 from native) - mean posterior L1 drift(registered_copy_m8 from native)

interventions.native: Each native view has a distinct registered parent.
interventions.registered_copy_m8: The donor view has total multiplicity eight and every copy shares the donor parent.
interventions.false_split_m8: Numerically identical donor copies are assigned distinct parents.
interventions.all_view_merge: All native views share one declared parent; this is a coarsening boundary, not a superiority arm.

donors.policy: Every native view is used once as donor.
donors.primary_aggregation: Compute each metric per seed and donor, average donors within seed, then average the five frozen seeds.
donors.worst_donor: Recomputed inside every bootstrap replicate; maximize loss/risk/drift metrics and minimize accuracy/F1.

support.selection: For each pair, gamma_min is max(0.10, the largest top equal-score-group coverage over registered-copy and false-split curves across every donor and seed); gamma_max is min(0.90, the smallest full attainable coverage). Selection uses scores and record counts only, never labels.
support.tie_rule: Analytic fractional inclusion within an equal-score group.

bootstrap.pairing: All five seeds, all donors, all arms, and all methods attached to a sampled record are carried together.
bootstrap.interpretation: Intervals are conditional on the five frozen emitter realizations.

required_equalities: predicted class equals native predicted class
evidence budget equals native evidence budget
selection-score tie groups equal native tie groups
all outcome metrics equal native outcome metrics

pairs.reason: The frozen per-view PIE evidence ledger and model checkpoint are absent locally and on the retained server paths. Aggregate outcome rows cannot reconstruct donor-complete interventions. The no-retraining rule is retained.
